import { Scene } from 'three';
import { EffectComposer } from 'three/addons/postprocessing/EffectComposer.js';
import { canonicalJson } from '../shared/canonical-json.ts';
import { helper } from './helper.ts';
import { StreamLogger } from '../cli/logger.ts';
import { chromium } from 'playwright-core';
import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';

/** Uses every import. */
export function build(): string {
  const scene = new Scene();
  const composer = new EffectComposer(helper());
  const log = new StreamLogger(1);
  log.info(String(chromium));
  return canonicalJson({ scene: scene.type, composer: String(composer), file: readFileSync('x', 'utf8') });
}
